## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD5: plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md and plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md updated to document ci.yml as the single PR-side entry point. Remove references to per-branch-review.yml.

## File Impact
| File | Action | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md | modify | (instruction-file — still-valid, no test task) |
| plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md | modify | (instruction-file — still-valid, no test task) |

## Implementation Notes
1. Update REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md: remove any references to per-branch-review.yml; note ci.yml's llm-review job as the single PR-side LLM-review entry point.
2. Update CI-INTEGRATION.md: remove any references to per-branch-review.yml; document the consolidation; cite story 20d7-09d6-b831-4c3a as the source change.
3. Doc-router gate check: Gate 2 fires (existing reference doc — CI-INTEGRATION.md). No Gate 5 trigger (do NOT touch CLAUDE.md).
4. DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION required in sub-agent completion report.

## TDD Requirement
GREEN — instruction-file changes per behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5. No RED test required. Doc-router attestation is the verification.

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md contains NO references to per-branch-review.yml
  Verify: ! grep -q 'per-branch-review' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md
- [ ] CI-INTEGRATION.md contains NO references to per-branch-review.yml
  Verify: ! grep -q 'per-branch-review' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] CI-INTEGRATION.md mentions ci.yml as the canonical/sole PR-side LLM-review entry
  Verify: grep -q 'ci\.yml.*llm-review.*sole\|sole.*ci\.yml\|canonical.*ci\.yml.*llm-review' plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] CLAUDE.md unchanged by this task (route via doc-router, not direct edit)
  Verify: ! git diff HEAD --name-only | grep -qx '^CLAUDE\.md$'
data.title: Doc updates: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md + CI-INTEGRATION.md reflect ci.yml as sole PR-side entry
